mapper.sql:
select i.instance_id, i.flow_id, i.flow_code, i.biz_type, i.biz_id, i.biz_title, i.biz_amount, i.current_node_id, i.status, i.start_user_id, i.start_time, i.end_time, i.create_by, i.create_time, u.nick_name as start_user_name, n.node_name as current_node_name, cc.customer_id as customer_id, cc.customer_name as customer_name from flow_instance i left join sys_user u on i.start_user_id = u.user_id left join flow_node n on i.current_node_id = n.node_id
left join crm_customer cc on cc.customer_id = (case i.biz_type when 'quote' then (select q.customer_id from biz_quote q where q.quote_id = i.biz_id) when 'contract' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = i.biz_id) when 'payment_reduce' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = (select p.contract_id from biz_payment_plan p where p.plan_id = i.biz_id)) when 'disclosure' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = (select d.contract_id from biz_disclosure d where d.disclosure_id = i.biz_id)) when 'stock_out' then (select ct.customer_id from biz_contract ct where ct.contract_id = (select o.contract_id from biz_stock_order o where o.order_id = i.biz_id)) end)
mapper.select: where i.biz_type = #{bizType} and i.biz_id = #{bizId} and i.status = '1' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into flow_instance (flow_id, flow_code, biz_type, biz_id, biz_title, biz_amount, current_node_id, status, start_user_id, start_time, create_by, create_time) values (#{flowId}, #{flowCode}, #{bizType}, #{bizId}, #{bizTitle}, #{bizAmount}, #{currentNodeId}, #{status}, #{startUserId}, sysdate(), #{createBy}, sysdate())
